overview: Mass Spectrometry is the field concerned with Weighing molecules to identify them: the most powerful analytical tool in chemistry and biology. What Mass Spectrometry Studies belongs to its essential core. Concretely: Ionization — turning neutral molecules into charged ions, by electron impact, ESI, or MALDI. And Tandem MS — fragmenting selected ions to read molecular structure piece by piece. Mastering this entry means being able to explain the topic in plain sentences, recognize it in real cases, and apply it alongside the neighboring ideas of the Foundations tier.

Molecular ion: the intact ionized molecule, giving the molecular weight.
